description.value: Harbour Oyster + Bar is a seafood-focused restaurant and bar situated on Commercial Drive, one of Vancouver's most culturally vibrant and cycle-friendly urban corridors. The venue centres on oysters and a bar program, offering a casual sit-down experience steps from the Drive's busy cycling lane. Its location makes it a convenient mid-ride stop for cyclists exploring east Vancouver.
